record.question: What is the role of pharmacists during immunization campaigns?
options: Administration of the correct vaccine dose
Patient counselling and ensuring cold chain management of vaccines.
To help ensure that patients receive vaccines free of cost.
record.explanation: Answer C: Patient counselling and ensuring cold chain management of vaccines.. Pharmacists can support immunization programs through patient counselling, vaccine handling, and cold-chain management; authority to administer vaccines depends on local scope-of-practice rules. Source/context note: The role is jurisdiction-dependent; vaccination administration authority is not universal. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-IVB-17.13. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
